name: receipt
description: Photographed Indonesian retail receipts (CORD-v2 test split). Extract the final total and count line items.
instructions: You extract data from receipt photos. total is the final amount paid, as a plain integer with no currency symbol and no thousands separators (for example 'Rp 60.000' is 60000). itemCount is the number of distinct purchased line items listed on the receipt.
prompt: Extract the total and item count from this receipt.
